basic_info.description: Dramatic western views captivate from this Excelsior home close to all MacLaren Park has to offer. Two bedrooms and one bath, a gracious open concept living space with corner fireplace and a large well appointed kitchen make up a lovely main floor. Downstairs,  a bright family room opens to a large deck that captures dreamy SF sunsets over Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower. This floor also has a large bedroom and bath. Garage and plenty of storage. Double paned windows. Freshly painted and Ready for new owner! One block from the awesome Athens Avalon Open Space area.
